lines: Built with: vite.config.mjs, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config ^2.5.2, vite ^7.3.2.
Every delivered file in js carries a source map, so every byte can be charged to the package and the module it came from.
24 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
